topic: Changes in Matter: Freezing and Melting
key_concepts: Matter can change form when heated or cooled
Temperature affects the form of matter
Hot objects have high temperature and cold objects have low temperature
A thermometer measures temperature in degrees Celsius or Fahrenheit
Melting is the change from solid to liquid
Freezing is the change from liquid to solid
Ice melts into water when placed in a warm place
Water freezes into ice when placed in a cold place such as a freezer
Butter, chocolate, ice cream, and sugar can melt when heated
Different liquids have different boiling points
Matter can be classified as solid, liquid, or gas
